SPEAK TO THE SCHOOL

Plan your visit

Visiting hours: Monday-Friday, 12:00-14:30. Call ahead to arrange your visit.

Call 015 065 0271All contact details
01

2027 learner applications

Late online applications: 19–30 November 2026

Parents and guardians who missed the earlier application period can apply for Grades R–7. Spaces are limited.

  • Grades R and 1: Apply online from 19 to 30 November 2026. The school offers help with online applications Monday to Friday, 07:30–14:00.
  • Grades 2–7: Collect and submit a manual application form at the school during school hours.

For admissions enquiries, call 076 259 2155 or 062 479 3466.

  • View the late applications poster
  • View the general admissions poster
02

What to bring

  • Copy of the parent’s ID
  • Copy of the learner’s birth certificate
  • Copy of pages 26 and 27 of the learner’s clinic card
  • Two passport photos of the learner

Bring these documents to the school if you need help with your application.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Your preparation checklist

Tick the items as you prepare. This checklist is for your own use and does not collect documents or submit an application.

0 of 5 preparation steps checked

Ask the school directly

  1. Which grades are offered, and are places available?
  2. When and how should an application be made?
  3. Which documents should I bring, and what if one is unavailable?
  4. What are the current school times and uniform arrangements?
  5. Who can help with learning support or access needs?

Contact the school to confirm available places, fees and placement decisions.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Good questions to ask.

Can I apply on this website?

For Grades R and 1, contact the school for help with the online application. For Grades 2–7, collect a form from the school. Do not send learner identity documents through this website or to the website developer.

What documents should I bring?

See the 2027 admissions document list above. Contact the school if you cannot provide an item.

Read general DBE admissions guidance
Where can I find admissions dates and school hours?

School and visiting hours are listed on our contact page. Admissions dates have not been supplied. Contact the school for current arrangements.

How can I support learning at home?

Try a short reading session, a counting activity or a conversation about something your child noticed. Our learning hub includes simple activities with no account required.

Open the learning hub

EVERYDAY SCHOOL LIFE

Small routines make a difference.

Before school

Check homework, pack learning materials and prepare clothing the evening before. Confirm arrival and collection arrangements with the school.

Stay in touch

Keep contact details up to date with the school. Discuss absences, learning concerns and changes to collection arrangements directly with staff.

Learning support

If a learner is struggling, start a conversation with their teacher. Share what you notice and ask which small activities will help at home.
